title: FrontRES Method-to-Code Reading Atlas
subtitle: 按 Concept Figure 设计点从左到右阅读方法对应的 owner 模块, 每张卡展示职责, 先读文件, 重点函数, 核心对象与模块内部主路径

systems.title: Method Data
systems.summary: 构造扰动并把动态片段送入训练

modules.title: Perturbation Data
modules.summary: 构造参考动作扰动, 当前实验使用 local_rp
modules.owns: 扰动 family, strength, schedule 与运行时注入
modules.mustNot: 不按扰动 family 缩窄 full-6D repair output

files.role: specialist mode 与正式配置入口

mainRoute: B1 train.py::_configure_frontres_motion_perturbations(): specialist config -> local_rp plan
B2 frontres_dr_curriculum.py: iteration state -> perturbation family + strength
B3 motion_perturbations.py: clean reference -> perturbed reference
review: 确认 family 只描述 corruption
确认 full-6D actor 不读取 active mask
modules.gap: 真实 family/strength 分布等待 live log

modules.title: Segment Replay
modules.summary: 采样并重放可恢复的动态片段
modules.owns: global/replay/review sampling, priority, segment state 与 trial planning
modules.mustNot: 不读取 post-update KL 或 logger state 计算 priority
mainRoute: B1 frontres_segment_sampler.py::sample(): sampler state -> selected segments
B2 frontres_segment_live_sampler.py::run_frontres_segment_sampler_step(): segments -> trial/reset/rollout batch
B3 FrontRESSegmentSampler.update_with_probe(): rollout Gain evidence -> updated priority
modules.gap: 真实 source/priority 分布等待 live log

modules.title: K-step Curriculum
modules.summary: 用 8/16/32/64 步窗口观察即时修复与延迟后果
modules.owns: per-row K assignment, horizon forwarding 与 K-step returns
modules.mustNot: 不把所有行静默固定为 K=8
mainRoute: B1 frontres_segment_sampler.py::plan_rollout_budget(): curriculum state -> per-row K
B2 frontres_segment_live_probe.py::_run_live_rollout_capture(): per-row K -> valid rollout steps
B3 frontres_segment_storage.py::compute_returns_and_advantages(): valid steps -> K-step return
review: 检查 done 后的 step mask
modules.gap: 真实 effective-K 分布等待 live log

systems.title: Initialization And Optimization
systems.summary: 从 supervised actor 过渡到受保护的 Segment PPO

modules.title: HSL Warmup
modules.summary: 用 task-space target 初始化同一个 full-6D actor
modules.owns: Stage 2 target, supervised actor update 与 model_warmup checkpoint
mainRoute: B1 frontres_hsl_rollout_target.py: Clean/Noisy rollout -> full-6D repair target
B2 frontres_unified.py: actor output + repair target -> supervised loss
B3 frontres_warmup.py::run_frontres_joint_warmup(): updated actor -> model_warmup.pt
review: 确认 Stage 2/3 actor head identity
确认 870D normalizer stats 持久化
modules.gap: 具体 Stage 2 artifact identity 由运行命令确认

modules.title: Actor & Critic Warmup
modules.summary: 先训练 critic, 再线性释放 HSL actor, 最后 joint PPO
modules.owns: critic_only, actor_warmup, joint phase 与 actor loss weight
modules.mustNot: 不恢复 retired authority/rho 或 generic PPO route
mainRoute: B1 frontres_segment_warmup.py::frontres_segment_warmup_phase(): persisted iteration -> phase + actor weight
B2 frontres_segment_ppo.py::compute_frontres_segment_ppo_loss(): PPO terms + actor weight -> total loss
B3 frontres_segment_live_probe.py::run_frontres_segment_single_update(): loss -> protected actor/critic update
review: resume 必须选择同一 phase
modules.gap: 真实 phase/gradient 证据等待 live log

systems.title: Repair And Execution
systems.summary: 输出完整修复并交给冻结 GMT 执行

modules.title: FrontRES 6D Repair
modules.summary: 从 870D observation 输出完整 Delta SE(3) 修复
modules.owns: actor distribution, bounded full-6D action 与 repaired reference write
modules.mustNot: 不替代 GMT, 不按 local_rp mask action dims
mainRoute: B1 front_residual_actor_critic.py::update_distribution(): 870D obs -> 6D mean/sigma
B2 frontres_action_cone.py::project_task_target(): sampled 6D action -> executable correction
B3 task_space_correction.py::apply_frontres_task_corrections(): correction -> repaired reference
review: 检查 raw/bounded/stored action 同源
检查 upward dz 约束不是 active mask
modules.gap: 真实 observation/action stats 等待 live log

modules.title: Frozen GMT
modules.summary: 执行 repaired reference, 参数保持冻结
modules.owns: GMT action inference 与 GMT-compatible observation suffix
modules.mustNot: 不进入 FrontRES optimizer, 不接收 gradient update
mainRoute: B1 frontres_runtime.py::apply_obs_normalizer(): actor observation -> GMT-compatible suffix
B2 front_residual_actor_critic.py: repaired reference + GMT obs -> GMT action
B3 frontres_unified.py::_collect_trainable_params(): policy params -> actor/critic optimizer without GMT
review: 确认 optimizer 不含 GMT params
modules.gap: 真实 update 中 GMT isolation 等待 live log

systems.title: Paired Evidence And Gain
systems.summary: 比较 Clean/Noisy/Repaired 执行并反馈 PPO 与 replay

modules.title: Paired Rollouts
modules.summary: 在同一 segment/K 下构造 Clean, Noisy, Repaired 执行证据
modules.owns: quartet roles, reset alignment, paired motion/physics capture
modules.mustNot: 不跨 motion/frame/K 错配比较对象
mainRoute: B1 frontres_training_setup.py::configure_frontres_pair_layout(): env rows -> explicit trial roles
B2 frontres_segment_reset.py: segment dynamic state -> aligned role reset
B3 frontres_segment_live_probe.py::_run_live_rollout_capture(): aligned roles -> paired execution evidence
review: 检查 Clean/Noisy/Repaired 的 segment/K identity
modules.gap: 真实 role/reset/physics population 等待 live log

modules.title: Repair Gain
modules.summary: 将 Style, Physics 与 Repair Cost 合成为统一训练信号
modules.owns: canonical Gain components, total Gain 与 PPO/replay consumers
modules.mustNot: 不回退到 environment reward 或 legacy RP score
mainRoute: B1 frontres_gain.py: paired rollout facts -> Style/Physics/Repair components
B2 frontres_gain.py::compute_segment_gain(): components -> gain_total
B3 live_probe.py + frontres_segment_ppo.py: gain_total -> storage return -> PPO and sampler feedback
